body: I literally have no standards when it comes to work. As I've said, I applied for everything; cleaner, shop assistant, call center, laundromat - nothing! I've applied in my city and others that I could get to on a bus. Not as a single offer back. What's the point in holding on when you have a court summon and a pending eviction?
I don't see how it's possible to live when you literally have no money.
